answer: The design leans on reputation decay for idle identities, weighted by independent path length, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Reaching the nadir of a payout therefore requires sustained, checkable labour rather than a crowd of fresh keys. Written in a verbs first, step by step register, it stays short. Work waits on the shale until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the vault of the next round. Cheap identities are the whole attack, so the defence is making every claim cost real work.
